defective_pattern: Emitting conversational reports or dialogues in Persian due to context bleed from inspecting Persian artifacts.
why_defective: Violates the user conversational protocol requiring English orchestration dialogue regardless of document language.
observed_symptoms: Stage completion report emitted in Persian
User feedback on English speaking rule violation
corrective_remedy: Decouple artifact target language from conversational orchestration language; strictly conduct all user-facing dialogue and reports in English.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of non-English characters in orchestration or conversational reports.
